english.title: Compel another to do / abstain from doing an act by threatening to destroy / damage a ship / sea platform
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in order to compel **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to

(A)_[do]_
(B)_[abstain from doing]_

an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), threatened that

(C)_[you]_
(D)_[some other person, namely **(..SPECIFY OTHER PERSON..),]_

would do an act, namely **(..SPECIFY UNLAWFUL ACT..), which was an offence by virtue of section 11(1) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990, the making of that threat being likely to endanger the safe navigation of a ship or the safety of a fixed platform
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13(1) and (5) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990.
